title: tensorflow/tensorflow
title_zh: 发布 TensorFlow 安装指南

paragraphs.en: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
paragraphs.zh: 面向每个人的开源机器学习框架

paragraphs.en: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning. It has a comprehensive, flexible ecosystem of tools , libraries , and community resources that lets researchers push the state-of-the-art in ML and developers easily build and deploy ML-powered applications.
paragraphs.zh: TensorFlow 是一个面向机器学习的端到端开源平台。 它拥有全面而灵活的工具、库和社区资源生态系统，让研究人员能够推动机器学习领域的最新进展，并让开发者能够轻松构建和部署由机器学习驱动的应用。

sents.en: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open source platform for machine learning.
sents.zh: TensorFlow 是一个面向机器学习的端到端开源平台。

sents.en: It has a comprehensive, flexible ecosystem of tools , libraries , and community resources that lets researchers push the state-of-the-art in ML and developers easily build and deploy ML-powered applications.
sents.zh: 它拥有全面而灵活的工具、库和社区资源生态系统，让研究人员能够推动机器学习领域的最新进展，并让开发者能够轻松构建和部署由机器学习驱动的应用。

paragraphs.en: TensorFlow was originally developed by researchers and engineers working within the Machine Intelligence team at Google Brain to conduct research in machine learning and neural networks. However, the framework is versatile enough to be used in other areas as well.
paragraphs.zh: TensorFlow 最初是由 Google Brain 机器智能团队的研究人员和工程师开发的，用于进行机器学习和神经网络方面的研究。 不过，该框架足够灵活，也可以用于其他领域。

sents.en: TensorFlow was originally developed by researchers and engineers working within the Machine Intelligence team at Google Brain to conduct research in machine learning and neural networks.
sents.zh: TensorFlow 最初是由 Google Brain 机器智能团队的研究人员和工程师开发的，用于进行机器学习和神经网络方面的研究。

sents.en: However, the framework is versatile enough to be used in other areas as well.
sents.zh: 不过，该框架足够灵活，也可以用于其他领域。

paragraphs.en: TensorFlow provides stable Python and C++ APIs, as well as a non-guaranteed backward compatible API for other languages .
paragraphs.zh: TensorFlow 提供了稳定的 Python 和 C++ API，以及一种不保证向后兼容的其他语言 API。

paragraphs.en: Keep up-to-date with release announcements and security updates by subscribing to announce@tensorflow.org . See all the mailing lists .
paragraphs.zh: 订阅 announce@tensorflow.org ，及时了解版本发布公告和安全更新。 查看所有邮件列表 。

sents.en: Keep up-to-date with release announcements and security updates by subscribing to announce@tensorflow.org .
sents.zh: 订阅 announce@tensorflow.org ，及时了解版本发布公告和安全更新。

paragraphs.en: See the TensorFlow install guide for the pip package , to enable GPU support , use a Docker container , and build from source .
paragraphs.zh: 请参阅 TensorFlow 安装指南，了解 pip 软件包、启用 GPU 支持、使用 Docker 容器以及从源码构建。

paragraphs.en: To install the current release, which includes support for CUDA-enabled GPU cards (Ubuntu and Windows) :
paragraphs.zh: 要安装当前版本（包含对支持 CUDA 的 GPU 显卡的支持）（Ubuntu 和 Windows）：

paragraphs.en: pip install tensorflow Other devices (DirectX and MacOS-metal) are supported using Device Plugins .
paragraphs.zh: pip install tensorflow 其他设备（DirectX 和 MacOS-metal）可通过设备插件（Device Plugins）获得支持。

paragraphs.en: A smaller CPU-only TensorFlow package is also available:
paragraphs.zh: 还提供了一个更小的仅使用 CPU 的 TensorFlow 软件包：

paragraphs.en: pip install tensorflow-cpu To update TensorFlow to the latest version, add the --upgrade flag to the commands above.
paragraphs.zh: pip install tensorflow-cpu 若要将 TensorFlow 更新到最新版本，请在上述命令中添加 --upgrade 标志。

paragraphs.en: Nightly binaries are available for testing using the tf-nightly and tf-nightly-cpu packages on PyPI.
paragraphs.zh: 可通过 PyPI 上的 tf-nightly 和 tf-nightly-cpu 软件包获取用于测试的每夜构建二进制版本。

paragraphs.en: $ python > >> import tensorflow as tf > >> tf . add ( 1 , 2 ). numpy () 3 > >> hello = tf . constant ( 'Hello, TensorFlow!' ) > >> hello . numpy () b'Hello, TensorFlow!' For more examples, see the TensorFlow Tutorials .
paragraphs.zh: $ python > >> import tensorflow as tf > >> tf . add ( 1 , 2 ). numpy () 3 > >> hello = tf . constant ( 'Hello, TensorFlow!' ) > >> hello . numpy () b'Hello, TensorFlow!' 更多示例请参阅 TensorFlow 教程 。

paragraphs.en: If you want to contribute to TensorFlow, be sure to review the Contribution Guidelines . This project adheres to TensorFlow's Code of Conduct . By participating, you are expected to uphold this code.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你想为 TensorFlow 做贡献，请务必阅读贡献指南。 本项目遵循 TensorFlow 的行为准则。 参与即表示你应遵守并维护该准则。

sents.en: If you want to contribute to TensorFlow, be sure to review the Contribution Guidelines .
sents.zh: 如果你想为 TensorFlow 做贡献，请务必阅读贡献指南。

sents.en: This project adheres to TensorFlow's Code of Conduct .
sents.zh: 本项目遵循 TensorFlow 的行为准则。

sents.en: By participating, you are expected to uphold this code.
sents.zh: 参与即表示你应遵守并维护该准则。

paragraphs.en: We use GitHub Issues for tracking requests and bugs, please see TensorFlow Forum for general questions and discussion, and please direct specific questions to Stack Overflow .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 GitHub Issues 来跟踪请求和缺陷，一般问题和讨论请参见 TensorFlow 论坛，具体问题请提交至 Stack Overflow。

paragraphs.en: The TensorFlow project strives to abide by generally accepted best practices in open-source software development.
paragraphs.zh: TensorFlow 项目致力于遵循开源软件开发中普遍公认的最佳实践。

paragraphs.zh: 请按照以下步骤为特定版本的 TensorFlow 打补丁，例如，修复错误或安全漏洞：

paragraphs.en: You can find more community-supported platforms and configurations in the TensorFlow SIG Build Community Builds Table .
paragraphs.zh: 您可以在 TensorFlow SIG Build 社区构建表中找到更多社区支持的平台和配置。

paragraphs.en: Learn more about the TensorFlow Community and how to Contribute .
paragraphs.zh: 了解更多关于 TensorFlow 社区以及如何贡献的信息。
